verdict.rationale: Brex markets AI-powered automation (invoice entry, GL coding, 'AI-powered financial operations') suggesting some data-driven suggestions, but there's no evidence of proactive AI-generated insights/analytics from user data. Community commentary directly disputes Brex's AI capabilities, citing hallucination risks, factual errors in AI demos, and a claim that Brex 'didn't successfully make the AI pivot' compared to competitor Ramp.
